title: Omega 3 Fatty Acids in Patients With Chronic Renal Disease

sections.abstract:
To study the tolerance and efficacy of an omega 3 fatty acids supplement on renal and vascular function and inflammatory parameters in patients with chronic renal disease

Posted outcomes: Number of Participants With a Urine Albumin Excretion Decrease of 20% or More. timeframe=At baseline and 12 weeks of intervention. Omega 3 Fatty Acids=19; Corn Oil=13. p=0.257
